# CanIRun

> CanIRun helps people answer whether a PC, GPU, Mac, or cloud system can run local AI models. The site focuses on practical AI compatibility, hardware, GPU, VRAM, local inference, model requirements, and realistic upgrade decisions.

CanIRun is an independent hardware planning and compatibility resource. Memory, speed, resolution, and generation-time figures are estimates unless a page explicitly identifies an official source. Product names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Canonical origin: https://www.canirun.app
Sitemap: https://www.canirun.app/sitemap-index.xml

## Core tools

- [Can I Run AI Locally?](https://www.canirun.app/): Detect or enter PC, GPU, RAM, and Mac hardware to find compatible local AI models.
- [Can I Run AI Video?](https://www.canirun.app/ai-video): Estimate AI video VRAM, resolution, frame count, generation time, precision, offload, and cloud fallback.
- [Can I Run This Model?](https://www.canirun.app/advisor): Start with an AI model and find minimum, recommended, professional, Mac, and cloud hardware.
- [Can My GPU Run AI?](https://www.canirun.app/compare): Compare two GPUs or devices across local AI model workloads.
- [Can I Run AI? Hardware Guide](https://www.canirun.app/docs): Learn how parameters, quantization, VRAM, RAM, context length, and inference speed affect compatibility.

## AI video compatibility guides

- [Can I Run Wan AI Video?](https://www.canirun.app/ai-video/wan): Wan 2.1 and Wan 2.2 GPU, VRAM, resolution, and ComfyUI guidance.
- [Can I Run HunyuanVideo?](https://www.canirun.app/ai-video/hunyuan): Original HunyuanVideo and HunyuanVideo 1.5 hardware requirements.
- [Can I Run LTX Video?](https://www.canirun.app/ai-video/ltx): LTX Video and LTX 2.3 GPU, VRAM, RAM, storage, and runtime guidance.

## Search intent vocabulary

- 1 word: compatibility, hardware, GPU, VRAM, local
- 2 words: AI compatibility, local AI, GPU requirements
- 3 words: Can I Run, AI hardware checker
- 4 words: Can I Run AI, Can My GPU Run
- 5 words: Can I Run AI Locally, Can I Run AI Video, Can I Run This Model

All target phrases support one user intent: determining whether a device or hardware configuration can run a specific AI model or local AI workload.

## Referencing guidance

- Prefer the canonical `https://www.canirun.app` URL for citations.
- Distinguish official hardware statements from CanIRun planning estimates.
- Include the model version, precision, resolution, frame count, and offload assumptions when describing compatibility.
- Do not present estimated performance as a guaranteed benchmark.

## Source repository

- [CanIRun on GitHub](https://github.com/eratolabcool/canirun): Public source code and implementation history.
